notes.title: The Race to AmadollaHo DLC
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35001913/abbaef171eb2d727fa5e4d8eaf85ebeef20f36fe.jpg[/img]

The sexiest Princess in the galaxy is coming to BoneCraft. On August 8th, D-Dub will release The Race to AmadollaHo DLC, which will add a new competition to BoneCraft. 

Can you save AmadollaHo from the robots that are keeping her prisoner? You'd better pack all the Jet Fuel you can chug, because this platform jumping competition is going to involve a lot of drinking. But when the reward is sex with a Princess, who wouldn't give it all they've got?

Get the DLC for free, and find AmadollaHo behind the Wranglers' crashed spaceship. Who needs to be rescued by Space Monks when you got Space Wranglers?

notes.title: Information about BoneCraft’s Release
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35001913/88d5a01c17857558af6e735b52090ebeab2cf98e.jpg[/img]

We are less than 2 weeks away from BoneCraft’s release on Steam! 

When we released the naughtiest Sci-Fi / Fantasy game ever created, we thought there’d be no way Steam would ever allow it, but here we are. The world has changed, for the better, and adult gamers are finally getting the adult games they deserve. BoneCraft is a game where any concerns for a M Rating were thrown out the door on the first day of development. So BoneCraft is totally not for children, but if you are an adult, I guarantee you’ve never played a game like this before. 

Some of you might have already played BoneCraft and are wondering what is different about the Steam version. For the Steam release, we have gone back over the graphics and gameplay, making improvements to bring it up to speed. We have also added Steam Stats and Achievements, so now you can not only put numbers to your conquests, but also unlock the most outrageous Steam Achievements you’ve ever seen, like Once You Go Green, or The Glory Hole. We have also integrated our three release girls (C3P-Ho, Robo-Ho, and Princess AmadollaHo) into the game, so everyone can experience them.    

You will be hearing more from us soon, as we build to the release of the most AO video game ever slung on the pages of Steam. So . . . if you’re interested in those sort of things, add BoneCraft to your Wishlist and make sure to not miss a thing.
